title: Learning gap
description: One tracked weakness. weeks[] is a per week log, oldest first: true correct, false wrong, null not tested or inconclusive.

status.description: resolved needs two clean appearances on unhinted, unambiguous items. parked means the skill is not taught yet, so it must not be retested until parkedUntil.

slot.description: which section slot re-tests this gap. Optional on older gaps, set it on new ones.

parkedUntil.description: date or term after which a parked gap may be retested

rung.description: the curriculum rung this gap blocks, e.g. 2C.3b
